title: A visitor makes the rounds
action: Visit each room once; follow the queue.
limit: Vertices are rooms; links are passages. Visiting a room is not walking each passage once.

title: An ant trail, drawn twice
action: Rearrange the drawing; keep every trail.
limit: Vertices are junctions, not individual ants. No pheromone or foraging behaviour is simulated.

title: The closed footbridge
action: Close one bridge; find the fewest-crossings detour.
limit: Passages have equal cost. A shortest graph route need not be the fastest or most accessible walk.

title: The post that gets copied
action: Omit one recorded share; recount incoming events.
limit: Vertices are accounts. Arrows are recorded shares, not friendships, impressions, agreement or trust.

title: An island with no return boat
action: Add a return crossing; compare the mutually reachable islands.
limit: A directed link is a scheduled service in this simplified model. Timetables and missed boats are omitted.

title: Water pipes between homes
action: Select cheap connections; break one; add a spare.
limit: Weights are assigned construction costs. This is connectivity planning, not water pressure or hydraulic flow.

title: Room for another delivery
action: Allocate two deliveries; notice the cancelled commitment.
limit: Capacities count crate slots in one interval. Reverse residual steps revise the plan before dispatch.

title: Two makers, two tools
action: Revise the first pairing so both people can work.
limit: Links encode declared task compatibility. One tool per person; preferences, skill and fairness are not computed.

title: A contact is not an infection
action: Advance one contact round; new infections wait until the next round.
limit: Toy SI process: probability0.35 per infectious-susceptible edge per round; no recovery, duration or biology. Not an epidemic forecast.

title: Seven bridges, four shores
action: Count odd degrees before attempting to use every bridge once.
limit: The seven-edge multigraph follows Euler's bridge problem. This is not a geographical reconstruction or the hall's vertex-visit lesson.

title: A neighbourhood after the relay fails
era: Future / invented scenario, not a forecast
action: Lose a central link; switch on the spare connection.
limit: Links are permitted communication paths, not guaranteed power, bandwidth, safety or equitable access.
